done_when: forge read skips a branch that disappears while it looks for the confirmed spec and carries on; a test deletes a branch between the listing and the lookup and sees the read succeed

findings.body: The test creates only an extensionless `#!/bin/sh` Git wrapper. On Windows, Forge's `shutil.which("git")` will use the real `git.exe` instead, so the branch is never deleted and the assertion on line 34 fails. The repository's test fixture explicitly creates `.cmd` shims for Windows (`tests/conftest.py:51-52`), and `.github/workflows/forge-next.yml` runs the suite on Windows. Add a Windows-compatible wrapper that deletes the branch before delegating to Git, so the required race test runs in that suite.
findings.title: Not done: the branch deletion regression test runs on Windows

why: forge read fails when a merge deletes a branch while it is listing branches to find the confirmed spec
